comment: Hand-curated SotDL rules data, verified against the rulebook text. Effects use the V2 choice-engine vocabulary; see docs for the schema.

advancement.note: Choose a novice path and gain its level 1 benefits.
Choose an expert path and gain its level 3 benefits.
Choose a master path (or a second expert path) and gain its benefits.
Master path level 10 benefits (or second expert path level 6 benefits).

second_expert_path.note: At level 7 you may choose a second expert path instead of a master path. Level 7: gain the second path's level 3 benefits. Level 9: gain the level 9 benefits from either of your expert paths. Level 10: gain the second path's level 6 benefits.
duplicate_talent_options: Increase one attribute of your choice by 1 and add one profession

attribute_rules.creation_swap: You can increase one attribute score by 1 by decreasing another by 1. You can make this adjustment only once.

magic_rules.dark_learn_note: Each time you learn a dark magic spell, roll a d6; if the roll is less than the total number of dark magic spells you know, gain 1 Corruption. Each dark magic spell grants 1 boon on rolls to avoid Insanity.
magic_rules.exchange_note: Whenever you learn a new spell, you may also exchange a previously learned spell for another of the same or lower rank.

wealth.equipment: A club or sling with 20 stones, rags, and a pouch containing 1d6 bits.
A staff or club or sling with 20 stones, patched basic clothing, a sack, bread, a waterskin, a tinderbox, a candle, and a pouch containing 2d6 bits.
A dagger, a staff or club or sling with 20 stones, basic clothing, a backpack, a week of rations, a waterskin, a tinderbox, 2 torches, and a pouch containing 1d6 cp.

A dagger, a staff or club or sling with 20 stones, fine clothing, a backpack, a cloak, a week of rations, a waterskin, a coil of rope, a tinderbox, 2 torches, a healing potion, and a pouch containing 2d6 cp. Plus one of: small shield; rank 0 incantation scroll; healer's kit, tool kit, or writing kit.

A dagger, courtier's clothing, a cloak, a backpack, a week of rations, a waterskin, a coil of rope, a tinderbox, a lantern, 2 flasks of oil, a healing potion, and a pouch containing 1d6 ss. Plus one of: shield; rank 0 incantation scroll; healer's kit, tool kit, or writing kit.
A dagger, noble's clothing, a cloak, a week of rations, a waterskin, a healing potion, and a pouch containing 2d6 ss. You also have a personal servant, a guard, and three horses with saddles.

ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.description: Determination, resourcefulness, and sheer numbers helped humanity become the most widespread people in the world.

creation.languages_professions: You speak the Common Tongue, and you can either speak one additional language or add a random profession.

effects.name: Determined
effects.text: When you roll a 1 on the die from a boon, you can reroll the die and choose to use the new number.

ancestries.name: Changeling
ancestries.description: Faerie doubles left in place of stolen mortal children, changelings can steal the appearance of others.

traits.name: Immune
traits.text: Damage from disease; charmed, diseased.

traits.name: Iron Vulnerability
traits.text: You are impaired while in contact with iron.

traits.name: Shadowsight
traits.text: You see into areas obscured by shadows as if those areas were lit.

traits.name: Steal Identity
traits.text: You can use an action to alter your appearance to match that of a target living creature you can see within short range. The target must be Size 1 or 1/2 and have a humanoid shape of flesh and blood. The effect lasts until you use this talent again. If you become incapacitated or touch an object made from iron, you immediately revert to your normal appearance.

effects.name: Doppelganger's Advantage
effects.text: You can use a triggered action on your turn to use Steal Identity. As well, when you steal a creature's identity, your attack rolls against that creature are made with 1 boon while you have that creature's appearance.

ancestries.name: Clockwork
ancestries.description: Mechanical bodies housing souls pulled from the Underworld, wound by keys and built for purposes long forgotten.

traits.name: Immune
traits.text: Damage from disease and poison; asleep, diseased, fatigued, poisoned.

traits.name: Key
traits.text: You have a key somewhere on your body that you cannot reach. If the key is turning, you count as a creature; if it stops, you count as an object. Your key stops turning when you become incapacitated or at the end of any round in which you got a 0 or less on an attack or challenge roll. Another creature can use an action to wind your key to start it turning again.

traits.name: Mechanical Body
traits.text: You do not eat, drink, breathe, or sleep, and you are unaffected by hot and cold environments.

traits.name: Repairing Damage
traits.text: You only heal damage from talents, spells, or repairs; resting alone does not heal you. A creature can use an action with a tool kit to repair you, healing damage equal to your healing rate.

effects.name: Grind the Gears
effects.text: You can increase the number of actions you can use on your turn by one. When you finish your turn, roll a d6. If you roll an odd number, you become an object at the end of the round.

ancestries.name: Dwarf
ancestries.description: Proud, stubborn folk of the mountain halls, renowned for craft, grudges, and iron constitutions.

creation.languages_professions: You speak the Common Tongue, and you speak, read, and write Dwarfish.

traits.name: Darksight
traits.text: You can see in areas obscured by shadows or darkness within medium range as if those areas were lit. Beyond this distance, you treat darkness as shadows and shadows as lit.

traits.name: Hated Creature
traits.text: Choose a hated creature type. Your hatred grants 1 boon on attack rolls made against creatures you hate.

traits.name: Robust Constitution
traits.text: You take half damage from poison. You make challenge rolls with 1 boon to avoid or remove the poisoned affliction.

effects.name: Shake it Off
effects.text: You can use an action to heal damage equal to your healing rate and remove one of the following afflictions: fatigued, impaired, or poisoned. Once you use this talent, you cannot use it again until after you complete a rest.

ancestries.name: Goblin
ancestries.description: Exiled faeries living on civilization's fringes — ugly, irreverent, and surprisingly hard to kill.

creation.languages_professions: You speak the Common Tongue and Elvish.

traits.name: Immune
traits.text: Damage from disease; charmed, diseased.

traits.name: Iron Vulnerability
traits.text: You are impaired while you are in contact with iron.

traits.name: Shadowsight
traits.text: You see in areas obscured by shadows as if those areas were lit.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.text: When you roll to become hidden or move silently, you make the Agility challenge roll with 1 boon.

effects.name: Spring Away
effects.text: When a creature you can see gets a failure on an attack roll against your Defense or Agility, you can use a triggered action to move up to half your Speed without triggering free attacks.

ancestries.name: Orc
ancestries.description: Bred for war by the Empire's sorcerers and newly freed from bondage, orcs carry rage and corruption in their blood.

creation.languages_professions: You speak the Common Tongue and Dark Speech.

traits.name: Shadowsight
traits.text: You see in areas obscured by shadows as if those areas were lit.

effects.name: Rising Fury
effects.text: When you take damage, you make your next attack roll before the end of the next round with 1 boon.

ancestries.name: Elf
ancestries.description: Ancient, beautiful, and perilous faeries of the hidden kingdoms, untouched by age but vulnerable to iron.

creation.languages_professions: You speak the Common Tongue and High Archaic. You also speak, read, and write Elvish.

traits.name: Immune
traits.text: Damage from disease; charmed, diseased.

traits.name: Shadowsight
traits.text: You see into areas obscured by shadows as if those areas were lit.

traits.name: Spell Defense
traits.text: You take half damage from spells and you make any challenge roll to resist a spell with 1 boon. A creature attacking you with a spell makes the attack roll with 1 bane.

traits.name: Bewitching Presence
traits.text: You make attack rolls in social situations with 1 boon. Lost while in contact with iron and for 1 minute afterward.

traits.name: Iron Vulnerability
traits.text: You are impaired while in contact with iron. Contact also suppresses Spell Defense for the duration and 1 minute afterward.

ancestries.name: Hobgoblin
ancestries.description: Grim faerie soldiers shaped by endless war, prone to terrifying battle frenzies.

creation.languages_professions: You speak Elvish, and you have the soldier profession.

traits.name: Immune
traits.text: Damage from disease; charmed, diseased.

traits.name: Iron Vulnerability
traits.text: You are impaired while you are in contact with iron.

traits.name: Shadowsight
traits.text: You see into areas obscured by shadows as if those areas were lit.

traits.name: Frenzy
traits.text: In combat, roll a d6 at the end of each round if you are neither incapacitated nor subject to this trait. On a 6, you become frenzied for 1 minute: immune to frightened, your attacks deal 1d6 extra damage, and all creatures that attack you make their attack rolls with 1 boon.

effects.name: Control Frenzy
effects.text: While you are subject to your Frenzy trait, you can use a triggered action on your turn to make a Will challenge roll. On a success, the Frenzy effect ends and you lose that trait for 1 minute.

ancestries.name: Pixie
ancestries.description: Tiny, glowing tricksters, invisible to most adults and barely there at all.

traits.name: Immune
traits.text: Damage from disease; charmed, diseased.

traits.name: Flutter
traits.text: You can move by flying, but if you fly higher than 5 yards above the ground, you fall.

traits.name: Naturally Invisible
traits.text: You are invisible to most creatures aside from other pixies, animals, demons, faeries, monsters, children, creatures with Intellect 7 or lower, and creatures with 5+ Insanity. Lost from noon to 1pm, midnight to 1am, at dawn and dusk, and for 1 hour after contact with iron.

traits.name: Glow
traits.text: You can use an action to become visible and illuminate the area within 2 yards of you, until you use an action to become invisible once more.

traits.name: Shadowsight
traits.text: You see into areas obscured by shadows as if those areas were lit.

traits.name: Iron Vulnerability
traits.text: You are impaired while in contact with iron.

traits.name: Wee
traits.text: Your weapon attacks deal half damage. Whenever you increase Health from a path, you increase your Health score by half the given amount.

effects.name: Dilate
effects.text: You can use an action to increase your Size to 1/2 until you use an action to return to normal. While dilated you lose Flutter, Naturally Invisible, and Glow, but gain +5 Strength, a Health bonus equal to 2 per group level, and your weapon attacks deal normal damage.

ancestries.name: Ferren
ancestries.description: Feline shapeshifters who have lived among humans for generations, hiding their nature by assuming the forms of ordinary cats.

traits.name: Shadowsight
traits.text: You see in areas obscured by shadows as if those areas were lit.

traits.name: Clawed Hands
traits.text: In human form, your unarmed strikes deal 1d3 damage instead of 1 damage.

traits.name: Cat Form
traits.text: You can use an action to assume the form of a cat or return to your human form. You remain in the new form until you use this talent again. If you become incapacitated while in cat form, you automatically return to human form. Everything you wear and carry is absorbed and cannot be used until you return. In cat form, your Size becomes 1/4; Perception increases by 2; Defense becomes 12; Strength becomes 8 (–2); Agility becomes 12 (+2); Speed becomes 12; you gain the climber trait; your claws and teeth are finesse natural weapons that deal 1 damage; you make rolls to hide or sneak with 2 boons; and you are indistinguishable from an ordinary cat, although you can still talk.

effects.name: Lynx Form
effects.text: When you would assume cat form, you can assume the form of a lynx instead. In lynx form, your Size becomes 1/2; Perception increases by 2; Defense becomes 13; Strength becomes 11 (+1); Agility becomes 13 (+3); Speed becomes 12; your claws and teeth are finesse natural weapons that deal 1d6 damage and attack with 1 boon; you make rolls to hide or sneak with 2 boons; and you are indistinguishable from an ordinary lynx, although you can still talk.

ancestries.name: Hamadryad
ancestries.description: Ancient daughters of the World Mother who can flow between humanoid and tree forms to defend the natural world.

creation.languages_professions: You speak the Common Tongue and Elvish.

traits.name: Shadowsight
traits.text: You see in areas obscured by shadows as if those areas were lit.

traits.name: Immune
traits.text: Damage from disease; charmed, diseased.

traits.name: Nature Stride
traits.text: You ignore the effects of moving across difficult terrain caused by roots, undergrowth, and trees.

traits.name: Vulnerable to Fire
traits.text: You take double damage from fire.

traits.name: Iron Vulnerability
traits.text: You are impaired while you are in contact with iron.

traits.name: Tree Form
traits.text: If you are standing on an earthen or rocky surface, you can use an action to return to your true form, a Size 3 tree. Everything you wear and carry transforms with you. In this form, you are blinded and immobilized, though you can perceive your surroundings and the passage of time. You cannot be moved unless incapacitated, at which point you die. The only action you can take is to assume your humanoid form.

effects.name: Deep Roots
effects.text: While standing on an earthen or rocky surface, you can use an action or a triggered action on your turn to root yourself. You become immobilized and cannot be moved by nonmagical means; your Defense becomes 15 if lower; and your weapon attacks deal 1d6 extra damage. The effect lasts until you become incapacitated or use an action or triggered action on your turn to end it.

ancestries.name: Molekin
ancestries.description: Small subterranean delvers driven to the surface after monsters overran their ancient tunnels beneath the Firepeaks.

creation.languages_professions: You speak the Common Tongue and Molekin. You have the miner profession.

traits.name: Darksight
traits.text: You see in areas obscured by shadows and darkness within medium range as if those areas were lit. Beyond this distance, you treat darkness as shadows and shadows as lit.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d3 damage instead of 1 damage.

traits.name: Deep Sense
traits.text: You cannot become lost while traveling underground.

traits.name: Nearsighted
traits.text: You make attack rolls against creatures beyond short range with 1 bane. You also make rolls involving anything you see beyond short range with 1 bane.

effects.name: Burrower
effects.text: You can dig through earth or sand, moving at half Speed. You leave behind a tunnel large enough to accommodate a Size 1/4 or smaller creature.

ancestries.name: Naga
ancestries.description: Serpentine refugees from a destroyed world who guard the Cosmic Egg and carry an innate gift for magic.

creation.languages_professions: You speak the Common Tongue and Naga.

traits.name: Venomous Bite
traits.text: When you make an unarmed strike, you can attack with your fangs. A success against a living creature forces it to make a Strength challenge roll. On a failure, it becomes poisoned for 1 minute. At the end of each round while poisoned in this way, it must succeed on a Will challenge roll or gain 1 Insanity.

effects.name: Invoke the Cosmic Egg
effects.text: You can use an action or a triggered action on your turn to invoke the Cosmic Egg for 1 minute. You impose 1 bane on attack rolls against you, make challenge rolls to resist attacks with 1 boon, recognize illusions, and see invisible creatures and objects within your vision. You can use this talent a number of times per day equal to 1 + your Power score and regain expended uses after a rest.

ancestries.name: Sylph
ancestries.description: Soulless people shaped from wind and cloud who once served the genies as wardens of the skies.

traits.name: Immune
traits.text: Damage from disease or poison; diseased, poisoned.

traits.name: Light as a Feather
traits.text: You never take damage from landing after a fall.

traits.name: Whirling Evasion
traits.text: When you would take damage from a creature you can see, you can use a triggered action to take half the damage and move up to 1d3 yards without triggering a free attack. This movement ignores difficult terrain.

traits.name: Dying Winds
traits.text: When you die, your body becomes a screaming whirlwind and dissipates. Each creature within 1 yard must make a Strength challenge roll. On a failure, it takes damage equal to your healing rate, moves 1d6 yards away, and falls prone. On a success, it takes half the damage.

effects.name: Zephyr Form
effects.text: When not submerged in liquid, you can use an action or a triggered action on your turn to become a zephyr for as long as you concentrate, up to 1 hour. You are invisible, gain +6 Speed and the flier trait, cannot fall while flying, are immune to all damage, can pass through air-sized openings and occupied spaces, and treat liquids as solid. Moving through a creature of your Size or smaller forces it to make a Strength challenge roll or move 1d3 yards away and fall prone.

ancestries.name: Yerath
ancestries.description: Peace-seeking insect people from the Patchwork Lands whose bodies and duties are shaped by a rigid hive caste system.

creation.languages_professions: You speak the Common Tongue and Yerath.

traits.name: Extra Arms
traits.text: Your second pair of arms is useful only for fine manipulation, carrying small lightweight objects, or minor activities. On your turn, you can use a triggered action to reload a weapon.

traits.name: Flutter
traits.text: You can use an action to unfurl your wings and move by flying at half Speed until the end of the round. While your wings are unfurled, you grant 1 boon on attack rolls against you.

traits.name: Musk
traits.text: You can use an action, or a triggered action when you take damage, to spray musk into a 1-yard cube you can reach. A creature there must succeed on a Strength challenge roll or become impaired for 1 round. You must wait 1 minute before using Musk again. The scent can communicate one concept to yerathi within 5 yards.

effects.text: You add laborer to your list of professions.
You add guide to your list of professions.
You add soldier to your list of professions.

effects.name: Swift Wings
effects.text: You can use a triggered action on your turn to use Flutter.

novice_paths.name: Warrior
novice_paths.description: Trained in the use of weapons and armor, warriors depend on toughness and combat skills to keep them alive. You need a high Strength or Agility to excel as a warrior.

effects.text: You add one common, martial, or wilderness profession.

effects.name: Catch Your Breath
effects.text: You can use an action or a triggered action on your turn to heal damage equal to your healing rate. Once you use this talent, you cannot use it again until after you complete a rest.

effects.name: Weapon Training
effects.text: When attacking with a weapon, you make the attack roll with 1 boon.

effects.name: Combat Prowess
effects.text: Your attacks with weapons deal 1d6 extra damage.

effects.name: Forceful Strike
effects.text: When the total of your attack roll is 20 or higher and exceeds the target number by at least 5, the attack deals 1d6 extra damage.

effects.name: Combat Expertise
effects.text: When you use an action to attack with a weapon, you either deal 1d6 extra damage with that attack or make another attack against a different target at any point before the end of your turn.

effects.name: Grit
effects.text: You can use Catch Your Breath twice between each rest.

effects.name: Combat Mastery
effects.text: When you use an action to attack with a weapon, you either deal 1d6 extra damage or make another attack against a different target. Cumulative with Combat Expertise; each attack needs a different target.

novice_paths.name: Rogue
novice_paths.description: Rogues always have a trick up their sleeves, relying on ingenuity, cunning, and good fortune. If you have a high Agility or Intellect, you will do well as a rogue.

effects.text: You either add one language to the list of languages you can speak or add one common, criminal, or wilderness profession.

effects.name: Nimble Recovery
effects.text: You can use an action to heal damage equal to your healing rate and then move up to half your Speed without triggering free attacks. Once you use this talent, you cannot use it again until after you complete a rest.

effects.name: Trickery
effects.text: Once per round, you can make an attack roll or challenge roll with 1 boon. If you attack with 1 boon from this talent, your attack deals 1d6 extra damage.

effects.name: Exploit Opportunity
effects.text: Once per round, when the total of your attack roll is 20 or higher and exceeds the target number by at least 5, you can take another turn at any point before the end of the round.

effects.name: Dirty Tricks
effects.text: Your attacks deal 1d6 extra damage when you make an attack roll with 1 boon.

effects.name: Rogue Cunning
effects.text: You can use Trickery twice per round.

novice_paths.name: Priest
novice_paths.description: Priests derive magical power from pledging service to a supernatural being, working magic through rite and prayer. A high Strength and Will help you excel as a priest.

effects.text: You either read one language you can speak or add a language to the list of languages you can speak. Also, add one religious profession.

effects.name: Shared Recovery
effects.text: You can use an action to heal damage equal to your healing rate. Then choose one creature other than you within short range; the target also heals damage equal to its healing rate. Once you use this talent, you cannot use it again until after you complete a rest.

effects.name: Prayer
effects.text: When a creature within short range of you makes an attack roll or challenge roll, you can use a triggered action to grant 1 boon on the triggering roll.

effects.name: Divine Strike
effects.text: When you use Prayer to grant a creature 1 boon on an attack roll, the creature's attacks with weapons deal 1d6 extra damage.

effects.name: Inspiring Prayer
effects.text: When you use Prayer on a creature other than yourself, you make attack rolls and challenge rolls with 1 boon for 1 round.

effects.name: Improved Shared Recovery
effects.text: You can use Shared Recovery twice.

novice_paths.name: Magician
novice_paths.description: Magicians strive to reach the heights of magical power, freely choosing their traditions to display a wide range of capabilities. You need a high Intellect or Will to excel as a magician.

effects.text: You read all the languages you know how to speak. In addition, you add one academic area of knowledge of your choice.

effects.name: Cantrip
effects.text: Whenever you discover a tradition, you learn an extra rank 0 spell from that tradition.

effects.name: Spell Recovery
effects.text: You can use an action to heal damage equal to your healing rate and regain one casting you expended of a spell you learned. Once you use this talent, you cannot use it again until after you complete a rest.

effects.name: Counterspell
effects.text: When a creature you can see attacks you with a spell, you can use a triggered action to counter it. The triggering creature makes the attack roll with 1 bane and you make the challenge roll to resist it with 1 boon.

effects.name: Improved Spell Recovery
effects.text: When you use Spell Recovery, you regain two castings instead of one.

roguery_talents.name: Backstab
roguery_talents.text: Once per round, when you attack with a basic or swift weapon and you make the attack roll with at least 1 boon, the attack deals 1d6 extra damage. Second pick: the extra damage increases to 2d6.

roguery_talents.name: Magic
roguery_talents.text: Increase your Power by 1 and discover one tradition. Then make two choices: discover another tradition or learn one spell. Second pick: increase your Power by 1 and discover a tradition or learn one spell.

roguery_talents.name: Skirmish
roguery_talents.text: You can use an action to move up to half your Speed without triggering free attacks. During the move, you can make an attack with 1 bane that deals 1d6 extra damage. Second pick: move up to your full Speed instead.

roguery_talents.name: Subterfuge
roguery_talents.text: You can use an action to make an Intellect attack roll against the Intellect of one creature within short range that can hear and understand you. On a success, the target is charmed for 1 round or until you attack it. On a failure, it becomes immune until it completes a rest. Second pick: roll with 1 boon and affect creatures that don't understand you.

roguery_talents.name: Threats
roguery_talents.text: You can use an action or triggered action to make an Intellect attack roll against the Will of one creature within short range that can hear and see you. On a success, the target is frightened for 1 round. On a failure, it becomes immune until it completes a rest. Second pick: your weapon attacks deal 1d6 extra damage to targets frightened this way.

talents.name: Giant Evasion
talents.text: Creatures of Size 2 or larger make attack rolls against you with 1 bane.

talents.name: Troll Slayer
talents.text: Your attacks against Size 2 and larger creatures deal 1d6 extra damage. Against trolls, your attacks deal 2d6 extra damage instead.
